verification_required: live smoke and browser QA pass where applicable
safety: Do not break existing production functionality
Do not publish fabricated, non-India or >30-day jobs
Never bypass authentication, CAPTCHA or platform restrictions
Never submit applications without a user review and approval for each application
Never store applicant secrets in public GitHub files
If a check fails, repair the active phase before advancing; if blocked by permissions or unknowns, stop and ask
